Strategy Lab

Every strategy test for both books. Coinbase goal: $569 → $1M by Oct 7, 2027 (≈1,750x, about /yr). Robinhood goal: +100% in 12 months. Research and paper only; nothing here places orders.

Heat map: every test, grouped by family

One cell per test. Families are ordered most→least profitable by each family's best OOS CAGR (falls back to in-sample CAGR when OOS is missing); cells inside a family use the same sort key, best to worst. The colour is OOS CAGR measured against the book's goal: red is a loss, grey is flat, green is a gain, and gold marks a test that meets the goal (failed and cost-estimate/proxy-option rows are hidden). Faded cells have no OOS result, so the colour shows in-sample. A white outline marks a candidate. Each family shows its count and avg OOS CAGR (mean of cells with out-of-sample data; median if the mean is outlier-skewed). Tap or hover a cell for details.

In-sample vs out-of-sample CAGR

Overfit strategies sit far right and low: great in-sample, poor OOS. Both axes are log(1+CAGR). The dashed line is y = x, and the gold lines are each book's goal.

Looking good ()

Status watch, candidate, forward-paper or live, or OOS CAGR > 0 with a robustness pass. "MC goal" is the share of 100k bootstrap paths that reach the book's goal. "Robust" means every ±20% parameter nudge and 2x costs stay profitable. "Holdout" is the locked Apr 2025–Oct 2026 result, evaluated once for frozen finalists only. Rows that failed the holdout are left out. Click a column header to sort.
